title: Vatican dossier and joint SS-Italian study of the Magenta object in a third country

tellings.quote: Vatican was informed of it and has a dossier on it and the Vatican was involved in the sort of study of this uh object um in a joint working group that involved both SS scientists and uh Italian scientists in a third party country.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher who writes about Nazi-era secret projects, told podcast host Jesse Michels about an object known as the Magenta object, said to have been studied in the 1930s and 1940s. Drawing on what a witness named David Grusch has said, Jorjani says the Vatican was informed of it, keeps a file on it, and took part in a joint working group of scientists from the SS, Nazi Germany's elite paramilitary force, and Italian scientists, meeting in a third country, which he links to Czechoslovakia. If true, it would mean an unexplained craft was being studied in Europe years before such stories became famous in America.
